usedFor: AgencyAnalytics holds your reporting clients, and Sangam CRM keeps the leads “Create or Update Lead” writes for each “New Client”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Client” in AgencyAnalytics, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: A new client account becomes a lead record, and an existing lead is updated by ID, email or phone.

watchOut: “New Client” checks on a schedule, so the lead appears after the next check, not when the client is added.
